summary: Iteration 4 backend testing complete. 32/32 new pytest cases pass (100%) and full regression is 113/113 (100%) across iteration 1 (27) + iteration 2 (29) + iteration 3 (25) + iteration 4 (32). Verified all 7 review-request acceptance criteria: (1) GET /api/workspaces returns 401 without bearer and 200 with the canonical {membership_id, company_id, company_name, industry, logo_color, role} shape; the 3 default memberships (owner@aidou_corp, manager@northstar_isp, employee@summit_construction) are present for a fresh user. (2) POST /api/workspaces/switch returns 401 without bearer, 403 if the user has no matching (company_id, role) membership, and 200 updates user.active_company_id + user.active_role — confirmed both in Mongo and via /api/auth/me. (3) GET /api/admin/users returns 401 unauth, 403 for role='member' + active_role='employee' and 'customer', 200 for active_role='owner', 'manager', and for legacy role='admin' (active_role unset); returns users[] with their memberships scoped to active_company_id. (4) POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/role returns 401 unauth, 403 for active_role='manager' (and not legacy admin), 400 for invalid role; 200 for owner; updates existing membership AND creates a new membership when the target user has none for that company — both verified via direct Mongo inspection. (5) DB-backed ops-brief cache: first call returns cached=false and persists key='ops_brief:co_aidou_corp' into db.cache with brief/metrics/fetched_at; second call within the hour returns cached=true with identical brief text; LLM fallback path is exercised gracefully. (6) Login auto-create memberships path is reachable by inspection (default companies present with expected industries Conglomerate/Telecom/Construction); the live POST /api/auth/session cannot be exercised without a real Emergent token but the inserted seed_user→workspaces→3-roles round-trip is asserted end-to-end. (7) Regression: 13 prior GET endpoints all 200 with no `_id` leak.
action_items: Optional: extract /api/workspaces, /api/admin/users, /api/admin/users/{id}/role into /app/backend/routers/workspaces.py + admin.py — server.py is now ~1170 lines and the role-management surface is logically separate from CRUD.

Optional: in POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/role, validate that the target user_id actually exists in db.users (currently it silently creates an orphan membership row if user_id is bogus). Not blocking, but tightens API contract.
Optional: enrich GET /api/workspaces with `picture` / total-company member count for richer UI cards — not required by review request.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth gating: GET /api/workspaces, POST /api/workspaces/switch, GET /api/admin/users, POST /api/admin/users/{id}/role all consistently call get_user_from_token() first; clean 401-before-anything-else pattern.
RBAC: admin/users uses an OR between active_role∈{owner,manager} and legacy role=='admin'; admin/users/{id}/role narrows that OR to active_role=='owner' OR legacy admin — matches the spec exactly.

Memberships uniqueness index on (user_id, company_id, role) prevents duplicate rows when the seed block re-runs; default-membership block is guarded by `existing_memberships == 0` so it is idempotent across logins.

DB cache key 'ops_brief:{company_id}' is correctly scoped per-company; cache.update_one(..., upsert=True) is the right pattern. The fetched_at timezone fallback (tzinfo=None → UTC) is defensive and correct.
POST /api/workspaces/switch correctly matches on the *role* AND company_id tuple, so a user with multiple roles in the same company can pick which role to operate under — sound design.
Note: /api/admin/users/{user_id}/role does NOT verify the target user actually exists — a typo'd user_id would still get a membership row inserted (minor; flagged in action_items).
No MongoDB _id leak found anywhere — all queries use projection {'_id': 0}.
seed_data_creation: Iteration 4 uses a `_make_user(mongo, role, active_role, with_memberships)` helper (not a fixture) so each test creates an isolated user with explicit role/active_role combinations and tears down (sessions + memberships + users) on completion. Test users are prefixed `user_<hex6>` with email `TEST_user_...@example.com`. db.cache entries for `ops_brief:co_aidou_corp` are wiped before the cache test to guarantee a cold-start. No persistent test data leaks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend suite is 113 tests: test_aidou_backend.py (27, iter1) + test_new_modules.py (29, iter2) + test_iteration_3.py (25, iter3) + test_iteration_4.py (32, iter4). Use _make_user helper for ANY role/active_role combo; mongo fixture is in conftest.py. The ops-brief cache is now DB-backed (db.cache) — to force a cold-start, mongo.cache.delete_many({'key': 'ops_brief:<co>'}). BASE_URL is sourced from EXPO_BACKEND_URL env var.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All 7 acceptance criteria validated by explicit assertions in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_4.py and the prior 81-test suite re-runs green confirming no regressions from the new workspaces/admin endpoints or the DB-backed ops-brief cache.
